improvedVsOld: Clearly better than the removed text overall. It applies the glossary and app labels consistently: „Wunschziele“, „Mit Stern“, „Gefällt mir“, intelligente Sammlungen, Detailseite instead of Ortsseite, Holiday Parks instead of Ferienparks, Freedom-Camping-Plätze, Backcountry-Hütten, Reiseroute, „Umsehen“ (Look Around). It removes the banned 'Offline Campingkarte' meta keyword and fixes the calques the style guide lists ('Nimm es mit auf die Straße', 'Schilder schlagen Bildschirme', the 'Nadeln' clustering sentence, 'Jeder Ort öffnet sich mit dem Detail'). It uses du-imperatives consistently and swaps 'Betreiber' for 'zuständige Stelle' where EN says land manager. It also restores a dropped fact: ui.calculatorNote now includes the 11 l fresh / 9 l grey water assumption that the old German left out. I found no em dashes, spaced en dashes, Sie, Führer, Offline-Karte or Campground in the added lines, and numbers, NZD, brand names and te reo terms (whenua, iwi, hapū) are intact. There are two small regressions: terms sections[5].heading went from 'Geistiges Eigentum' to the narrower 'Urheberrecht', and ui.to went from 'Nach' to the weaker 'In'.
criticalIssues: The privacy page structure does not match English. pages.privacy in de.json has 6 sections, en.json has 7. The 'Website analytics' section (GA4, the _ga cookies, the 13-month cookie expiry, consent for EEA/UK/CH, 14-month retention) is missing entirely, and the retention and children/contact sections are each shifted up one index. Because isPageComplete in lib/localized.ts requires matching section and paragraph counts, /de/privacy currently falls back to the full English page. Nothing wrong is shown to users, but the German privacy page is not translated, and the three privacy units this branch edits never render. This was already broken on origin/main and the branch does not fix it. Fix: add a translated sections[4] for Website analytics with 4 paragraphs and move the existing two sections to [5] and [6].

Not a translation issue, but worth fixing: price-table dates come from lib/content (asOf, for example '12 August 2026') and are not localized. German pages therefore render 'Preise geprüft am 12 August 2026' without the day dot the style guide requires ('12. August 2026').
